prompt: Create a refined editorial portrait poster for a new Chinese-style photo collection. A graceful middle-aged East Asian woman with soft oval face, bright almond eyes, natural brows, gentle smile, fair skin, elegant mature beauty stands slightly left of center, turned three-quarters toward the camera, looking directly at the viewer with a calm, warm expression. She wears a sleeveless pale gray-beige qipao/cheongsam with subtle botanical print, muted green piping, and traditional frog closures at the collar and chest. Her black hair loosely pinned in a low updo with a white magnolia flower tucked behind one ear is elegant and slightly wispy. Surround her with white magnolia blossoms: count 5 visible flower clusters on branches, including 2 soft blurred foreground clusters at the lower left and left edge, 2 sharp upper-left branching clusters arching across the top, and 1 branch held near the lower right. Use a dark blue-gray textured studio backdrop, cinematic soft side lighting, shallow depth of field, delicate haze, realistic skin texture, high-end portrait photography, quiet poetic Chinese aesthetic, muted cool tones, fine art magazine cover composition. Add large elegant thin serif title text across the bottom reading BLOOM IN SILENCE; beneath it add smaller Chinese text reading 静放花开 with thin horizontal divider lines and a small floral icon. In the upper right, add small refined vertical typography: Chinese text “新中式写真作品集”, below it small English text “NEW CHINESE STYLE PHOTO COLLECTION”, a short horizontal line, then vertical Chinese words “静温 / 水柔 / 戴有 / 心骨”, followed by a small flower icon and a thin vertical line. Keep typography pale gray-white, minimal and airy. Portrait orientation 3:4, luxury editorial poster, photorealistic, no watermark, no extra people, no modern props.

promptZh: 为全新的新中式摄影作品集创作一张精致的杂志风人像海报。一位优雅的东亚中年女性，拥有 柔和的鹅蛋脸、明亮的杏眼、自然的眉形、温婉的笑容、白皙的皮肤，展现出优雅成熟之美，站在画面偏左位置，身体侧向镜头四分之三处，直视镜头，表情平静而温暖。她身着一件无袖浅灰米色旗袍，饰有淡雅的植物印花、柔和的绿色滚边，领口和胸前配有传统盘扣。她的 黑色秀发松散地盘成低发髻，耳后别着一朵白玉兰花，造型优雅且带有几分灵动。周围环绕着白玉兰花：画面中可见 5 簇花枝，包括左下角和左边缘 2 簇柔焦前景花丛，左上方 2 簇横跨顶部的清晰花枝，以及右下方手持的 1 簇花枝。背景采用深蓝灰色纹理摄影棚背景，运用电影感柔和侧光、浅景深、细腻雾气，呈现真实皮肤质感、高端人像摄影风格、静谧诗意的新中式美学、低饱和冷色调以及艺术杂志封面构图。在底部添加大型优雅纤细的衬线标题文字 BLOOM IN SILENCE；下方添加较小的中文副标题 静放花开，并配以纤细的水平分割线和小型花卉图标。在右上角添加精致的竖排文字：中文“新中式写真作品集”，下方为小型英文“NEW CHINESE STYLE PHOTO COLLECTION”，配以短横线，随后是竖排中文“静温 / 水柔 / 戴有 / 心骨”，末尾点缀小型花卉图标和纤细竖线。排版保持浅灰白色，风格简约通透。人像比例 3:4，奢华杂志海报质感，照片级真实，无水印，无无关人物，无现代道具。
